newsitem.title: USA: IBM, Prudential in $340-mln service deal.
newsitem.headline: IBM, Prudential in $340-mln service deal.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America and International Business Machines Corp said Thursday they have reached a $340 million, five-year agreement under which an IBM subsidiary will provide information technology services to two Prudential units.
The agreement also allows the IBM subsidiary providing the service, Integrated Systems Solutions Corp, to offer jobs to about 900 Prudential employees, the companies said.
Under the agreement, Integrated Systems will provide maintenance for some Prudential systems used by its individual insurance and money management groups.
